dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High prominence and sharp boundary contrast of white transverse bars on the lower flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Small, rectangular red patch at the junction of the crown and nape.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Indistinct and gradual transition from dark crown to dark grey mantle.
